nodes.label: Internal oscillator (set by your code)
nodes.tooltip: The internal oscillator frequency is chosen at runtime (OSCCON/OSCFRQ): enter the frequency your code sets.

constraints.message: HS oscillator: High-speed crystal/resonator on RA6/OSC2/CLKOUT and RA7/OSC1/CLKIN: the external frequency must be 4 MHz or more.
XT oscillator: Crystal/resonator on RA6/OSC2/CLKOUT and RA7/OSC1/CLKIN: the external frequency must be 0.1-4 MHz.
